DEPENDENT_VARIABLE_DEFINITIONS:
Electric_Powered_Vessels_Deployed = Number of fully electric ships in operation or trials
LNG_Powered_Vessels_Deployed = Number of Liquefied Natural Gas vessels deployed
Hybrid_Vessel_Deployment = Number of hybrid-powered ships in service
High_Emission_Ships_Eliminated = Number of non-compliant high-polluting vessels removed from service
Sulfur_Emission_Limits = Maximum permissible sulfur content in marine fuel (decreasing limits)
Engine_Efficiency_Standards_Met = Percentage of fleet meeting modern efficiency requirements
Green_Corridor_Miles_Established = Length of river routes with enhanced environmental protection
Vessel_Compliance_Rate = Percentage of active vessels meeting environmental standards
Shore_Power_Installations_Deployed = Number of ports with on-shore electrical connection capability
Idle_Emission_Reduction = Percentage decrease in emissions while vessels are docked
Waste_Reception_Facilities = Number of ports with proper waste handling infrastructure
Empty_Run_Reduction = Percentage decrease in cargo-empty return trips
Route_Optimization_Implementation = Percentage of fleet using AI-optimized routing
Multimodal_Integration_Coverage = Percentage of waterways connected to rail/road networks
Real_Time_Tracking_Adoption = Percentage of fleet using IoT monitoring systems
Wetland_Restoration_Area = Total square kilometers of restored wetland habitat
Fish_Passage_Installation = Number of fish-friendly passage systems at locks/dams
INDEPENDENT_VARIABLE_DEFINITIONS:
Policy_Initiative = Type of environmental regulation or incentive program
Technology_Type = Category of green technology (Electric
Implementation_Phase = Stage of rollout (Pilot
Regulatory_Standard = Specific environmental requirement or limit value
Investment_Level = Amount of funding allocated to green initiatives
